rules.label: Gift card strip and event takeover

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Steam store gift-card strip and featured carousel; blur/hide artwork and prices; dim or hide rows
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on store.steampowered.com (home): iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Steam served the same responsive markup to both. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and ids of games stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main content and the sign-in link).

LIVE: `#gift_card_banner_mobile` 1, `.static_takeover_ctn` 1, `#home_maincap_v7` 1 (the featured carousel, holds 12 `.store_main_capsule`), `.capsule_image_ctn` 95 (the main capsule is a div with a background image), `.large_screenshot` 48, `.sale_capsule img` 33, `.discount_block` 125, `#module_recommender` 1, `#module_deep_dive` 1, `.recommended_creators_ctn` 1, `.recently_updated_block` 1, `.content_hub_carousel_ctn` 1, `#home_tab_section_autoload` 1, `#home_accountblocks_section` 1, `.game_review_summary` 13, `.review_summary` 12. The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing on this page.

Choices: Game artwork Show/Blur/Hide; Prices and discounts Show/Blur/Hide; Recommendation rows Show/Dim/Hide. Steam's JS-rendered React blocks use hashed class names; no rule relies on them.

SOURCE: a community uBlock list (krc gist) hides `.banner_open_in_steam`; that element did not appear in either capture, so no rule was added for it.

NOT verified: app (game) pages, search results, community hub, the age-gate page, logged-in store (personalised rows differ), non-English store languages. Hiding `#home_maincap_v7` removes the whole featured carousel including its Steam Deck / event slides.
